visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white skirt and a light green sweater, stands with her back to the camera in front of a traditional red Japanese Torii gate at a shrine. She walks through a narrow, dark rocky crevice where water trickles down the mossy stone walls. (2) Close-up of a bronze dragon-shaped water basin with wooden ladles resting on it. The scene cuts to a high-angle shot of a bright blue coastline with palm trees and a road running alongside the shore under a clear sky. (3) A sequence of shots showing a lavish lobster seafood feast on a table, followed by the woman sitting at a dining table, smiling brightly and holding her cheeks in excitement. (4) A blue and white bus labeled 'Asa Coast Railway Company' pulls up to a station. The woman, now wearing a beige coat, boards the bus. An interior shot shows her sitting by the window, followed by a view through the bus doors looking out at the ocean as it travels along a road. (5) The bus stops at a level crossing with yellow and black gates. It undergoes a mechanical transition where train wheels descend from its chassis onto the railway tracks. A small screen inside the bus displays the rear wheels changing. (6) The vehicle, now acting as a train, travels along the railway tracks through a rural landscape with hills and fields. The woman is seen inside the bus looking out at the scenery.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我來到日本德島縣最南端的海陽町. [Logo]: @MaoMaoTV. (2) [Subtitle]: 這裡有山林深處有虔誠信仰. (3) [Subtitle]: 也擁有美麗大海的舒服小鎮. (4) [Subtitle]: 晚上我為自己準備了人生中吃過最豪華的龍蝦大餐. (5) [Subtitle]: 準備展開兩天一夜小旅行. (6) [Subtitle]: 讓我驚訝的是, 在這個樸素的小鎮竟然有, 不只是日本唯一! 還是世界首創! (7) [Subtitle]: 只有在這裡才有辦法體驗, 坐上公車暢遊鐵路軌道的神奇感覺. (8) [Subtitle]: 這台車叫DMV. (9) [Subtitle]: 只需要15秒, 就可以從公車切換到鐵軌模式. (10) [Subtitle]: 真的超級有趣 人生初體驗! (11) [Subtitle]: 背景音樂還是當地高中生打的太鼓. (12) [Subtitle]: (太喜歡這個冷靜的配音了XD) 專業冷靜的動漫感xDDD. (13) [Subtitle]: 我真的沒有想到, 在日本一個安靜的濱海小鎮, 可以有這麼好玩的體驗.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Cheerful female narration begins with high energy over an upbeat, rhythmic piano and drum-driven BGM. Faint natural sounds of running water are audible in the background. (2) The narration remains continuous and lively as scenes shift, with the BGM maintaining a constant, bright tempo. (3) A sudden mechanical engine hum of a bus enters the mix, accompanied by the female narrator's enthusiastic description of the vehicle. (4) The sharp 'ding-ding' sound of a railway crossing alarm triggers a shift. A deep, resonant, and calm male voice in Japanese says 'Finish', marking the completion of a mechanical process. Audible thuds and metallic clicks of wheels shifting are layered under the voices. (5) A rhythmic clacking sound of wheels on tracks becomes the dominant ambient layer, resembling a train's motion. The female voice returns with a high-pitched, joyful conclusion as the music swells slightly for the outro.
